sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
அனந்த ரூபிணி அகில ரக்ஷகி
அன்னபூரணி அமர பாலினி
sections.translit:
anantha rUpiNi akila rakshaki
annapUraNi amara pAlini
sections.en: Goddess of infinite forms, protector of the universe, nourisher of the world, you are also the guardian of the immortal devas.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
அம்புலி சோதரி அம்புஜ தாரிணி
அம்ருத பாஷிணி அநாத பந்து நீ
sections.translit:
ambuli sOdhari ambuja dhAriNi
amrutha bhAshiNi anAtha bandhu nI
sections.en: You are the sister of the moon god, Chandra; you are seated on a lotus. Your speech is as sweet as nectar. You are the savior of the orphaned and the destitute.

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
அலைகடலிடையே அரியின் அருகே
அமர்ந்த அழகே அதர அசைவால்
அனைத்தும் அனுக்ரஹிக்கும் அன்னையே
அல்வழி அகற்றி அறிவும் அறமும்
அமோக வளமும் அளித்திட அருள் நாடி
அடியேன் அடைக்கலம் அடைந்தேன் அம்பிகே
sections.translit:
alaikadalidaiyE ariyin arugE
amarndha azhagE adhara asaivAl
anaitthum anugrahikkum annaiyE
alvazhi agattRi aRivum aRamum
amOga vaLamum aLitthida aruL nAdi
adiyEn adaikkalam adaindhEn ambikE
sections.en: The beautiful goddess is seated next to Hari in the ocean. She is the divine mother who grants everything with a simple movement of her lips. Oh, Goddess, this humble devotee seeks refuge with you, so I can avoid evil ways. Bless me with intellect, righteousness (the path of dharma), and boundless prosperity.

notes: This song is the author’s attempt to employ alliteration in the Pallavi, Anupallavi, and Charanam. It is a salutation to Goddess Mahalakshmi, who is seated beside Lord Vishnu in the milky ocean. Inspired by both its style and content, Smt. Asha Ramesh has set this song to the raga Asaveri.
